
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(labelled)
library(questionr)

F4_F2 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_F4_F2_pour_long.csv", show_col_types = F)
```

# Pivot longer
```{r}

vars_num <- F4_F2 %>% 
  select(starts_with("fa_frt")) %>%
  select(-where(is.character)) %>% 
  colnames()

F4_F3 <- F4_F2 %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = all_of(vars_num),
      .fns = ~ if_else(.x == -7, NA_integer_, .x)
    )
  )

vars_to_pivot <- F4_F3 %>% 
  select(starts_with("fa_frt")) %>% 
  colnames()

fratrie0_long <- F4_F3 %>%  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(vars_to_pivot),
    names_to = c("rang_frt", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "fa_frt(.\\d+)_(\\w+)",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )


```

# Renommer variables

```{r}

vars_module <- fratrie0_long %>% 
  select(prenom:deces_an) %>% 
  colnames()

fratrie1_long <- fratrie0_long %>% 
  rename_with( ~ paste0("fa_frt_", .x), all_of(vars_module)) %>% 
  rename("fa_fr_rang" = "rang_frt")

rm(list = c("vars_module", "vars_num", "vars_to_pivot"))

```

# Introduire tagged_na

```{r}

source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/rcd_tagged_na_1rep.R")
source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/lbl_levels_na.R")
library(labelled)

vars_1rep <- fratrie1_long %>% 
  select(where(is.double)) %>% 
  select(-fa_fr_date_creation) %>% 
  colnames()

# Les deux fonctions fonctionnent!

fratrie2_long <- fratrie1_long %>%
  rcd_tagged_na_1rep(all_of(vars_1rep)) %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_1rep), lbl_levels_na))

table(as_factor(fratrie2_long$fa_frt_sexe), useNA = "ifany")

rm(list = c("vars_1rep", "lbl_levels_na", "rcd_tagged_na_1rep"))

```

# Ajouter value labels

```{r}
source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/rcd_mois.R")
source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/lbl_oui_non.R")

all_mois <- fratrie2_long %>% 
  select(contains("mois")) %>% 
  colnames()

vars_bin <- fratrie2_long %>% 
    select(fa_frt_diag_avt_nais, fa_frt_muco, fa_frt_decede) %>% 
    colnames()

fratrie3_long <- fratrie2_long %>% 
  mutate(
    across(all_of(all_mois), rcd_mois),
    across(all_of(vars_bin), lbl_oui_non)
  ) %>%
    add_value_labels(
        fa_frt_sexe = c(
            "Male" = 1,
            "Female" = 2
        ),
        fa_frt_issu = c(
            "Full sibling" = 1,
            "Half-sibling" = 2,
            "Adopted sibling" = 3
        )
    )

table(as_factor(fratrie3_long$fa_frt_decede), useNA = "ifany")

rm(list = c("rcd_mois", "lbl_oui_non", "all_mois", "vars_bin"))
```

## Verifier qu'il ne reste plus de neg

```{r verif rcd}

verif_ch <- fratrie3_long %>%
  filter(if_any(where(is.character), ~ grepl("^-\\d", .)))

verif_db <- fratrie3_long %>% 
  filter(if_any(where(is.numeric), ~ . < 0))

rm(list = c("verif_ch", "verif_db"))

```

# Ajouter variable labels

```{r}
fratrie4_long <- fratrie3_long %>% 
  set_variable_labels(
    id_anonymat = "Respondent unique identifier",
    fa_fr_nb_frt = "No. of siblings per resp.",
    fa_fr_date_creation = "Siblings module completion date",
    fa_fr_rang = "Siblings order",
    fa_frt_prenom = "F49 Sibling name",
    fa_frt_sexe = "F50 Sibling sex",
    fa_frt_nais_mois = "F51 Sibling DOB (month)",
    fa_frt_nais_an = "F51 Sibling DOB (year)",
    fa_frt_issu = "F52 How this sibling joined the family",
    fa_frt_adpt_mois = "F53 Sibling date of adoption (month)",
    fa_frt_adpt_an = "F53 Sibling date of adoption (year)",
    fa_frt_diag_avt_nais = "F54 Sibling had prenatal CF diagnosis",
    fa_frt_muco = "F55 Sibling has/had CF",
    fa_frt_decede = "F56 Sibling deceased",
    fa_frt_deces_mois = "F57 Sibling date of death (month)",
    fa_frt_deces_an = "F57 Sibling date of death (year)"
  ) %>% 
    mutate(
        fa_fr_rang = as.integer(fa_fr_rang)
    )
```
